# The `clustering` artefact

Everything later chapters need is saved as one artefact, `clustering`.
Per-observation arrays have one row per observed country-year in the order
of `c_idx`, `t_idx` (by population, then year).  Age columns of the core
are 0-based in the arrays (column 0 is the level).

| Key | Shape / type | Content |
|---|---|---|
| `c_idx`, `t_idx` | (n_obs,) int | population and year index of each observed country-year |
| `pops`, `years` | (C,), (T,) | population codes and calendar years of those indices |
| `e0` | (n_obs, S) | e₀ of the observed schedule (female, male); `e0_mean` (n_obs,) is their average |
| `K`, `labels`, `posterior` | int, (n_obs,), (n_obs, K) | clusters 0 … K−1 (figures and paper: 1 … K), numbered by mean e₀; K is the reproducible K of Step 5 |
| `K_bic` | int | the K with the lowest BIC (not used for the partition) |
| `noise_clusters` | (m,) int | clusters flagged as small-population noise clusters (Step 8); exclude them when using the clusters |
| `noise_measures` | dict | `excess_log_roughness` (n_obs,) log₁₀ roughness minus its e₀-conditional mean, `small` (n_obs,) bool, in the smallest quarter by population size (Step 8) |
| `stability` | dict | `reproducibility` (ARI between refits, by K), `bootstrap_by_k` (Jaccard and ARI under resampling of population families, by K), `jaccard` (K,) each cluster's mean Jaccard, `jaccard_present` (K,) resamples holding the cluster |
| `features` | dict | `n_columns` (k), `index` (p, 2) = (sex component, age column) of each feature, `raw` (n_obs, p) core entries, `values` (n_obs, p) level-free features |
| `conditional_mean` | dict | `e0_grid` (g,), `core` (g, r₁, r₂) e₀-conditional mean of the full effective core, `features` (g, p) the same at the feature positions, `frac`, `iterations` |
| `residual_mean` | (K, p) | each cluster's mean feature vector |
| `residual_core` | (K, r₁, r₂) | the same in core coordinates (zero outside the feature positions) |
| `deviation_logit` | (K, S, A) | the cluster's deviation $\mathbf{S}\mathbf{D}_k\mathbf{A}^\top$ in logit(q_x) |
| `member_mean_core`, `member_mean_e0` | (K, r₁, r₂), (K,) | mean effective core and mean e₀ of the members |
| `pca`, `scores` | dict, (n_obs, d) | `mean`, `components` (p, d), `explained_variance_ratio`, `d`; the reduced features |
| `gmm` | dict | `weights`, `means`, `covariances`, `covariance_type` (in PCA coordinates) |
| `bic` | DataFrame | BIC/AIC for every K |
| `ward_labels`, `ward_agreement`, `ward_ari` | | Ward groups (matched to clusters) and agreement |
| `country_cluster`, `year_cluster` | (C,), (T,) int | majority labels (−1: no observed country-years) |
| `level_sign`, `e0_per_level` | int, float | σ and b of Part B |
| `epochs`, `epoch_years`, `epoch_windows` | DataFrames | epoch table, per-year categories, window slopes |

To build the schedule of cluster `k` at a target life expectancy `x`:

```python
core = clus.conditional_core_at(x, art["conditional_mean"]["e0_grid"], art["conditional_mean"]["core"])
core = core + art["residual_core"][k]                       # (r1, r2)
logit_qx = tz.schedules_from_cores(core, tucker["U_sex"], tucker["U_age"])   # (S, A)
```

Its e₀ is close to, but not exactly, `x` (Step 3); adjust the level
coordinate `core[0, 0]` if an exact e₀ is required.  A new schedule (e.g. a
fitted one) is placed in the clusters' feature space with
`clus.cores_to_features(G, index) − clus.cores_to_features(conditional_core_at(e0, …), index)`
followed by `clus.pca_transform(…, art["pca"])`.

```{python}
#| label: c06-save
#| code-summary: "Assemble and save the clustering artefact"
def _assemble():
    return {
        "c_idx": c_idx, "t_idx": t_idx, "pops": pops, "years": years,
        "e0": e0_sex, "e0_mean": e0,
        "K": K, "K_bic": K_bic, "labels": labels, "posterior": chosen["posterior"],
        "noise_clusters": noise_clusters,
        "noise_measures": {"excess_log_roughness": excess_rough, "small": small},
        "features": {"n_columns": int(k_cols), "index": fidx, "raw": F_raw, "values": R},
        "conditional_mean": {"e0_grid": e0g, "core": core_grid, "features": F_grid,
                             "frac": PF["conditional_frac"], "iterations": PF["conditional_iterations"]},
        "residual_mean": residual_mean, "residual_core": residual_core,
        "deviation_logit": np.moveaxis(deviation, -1, 0),
        "member_mean_core": member_mean_core,
        "member_mean_e0": np.array([e0[labels == k].mean() for k in range(K)]),
        "pca": {k_: pca[k_] for k_ in ("mean", "components", "explained_variance_ratio", "d")},
        "scores": X,
        "gmm": {"weights": chosen["weights"], "means": chosen["means"], "covariances": chosen["covariances"],
                "covariance_type": PG["covariance_type"]},
        "bic": bic_table,
        "stability": {"reproducibility": repro_table, "bootstrap_by_k": boot_by_k,
                      "jaccard": jac_K, "jaccard_present": present_K},
        "ward_labels": ward_labels, "ward_agreement": ward_agree, "ward_ari": float(ward_ari),
        "country_cluster": country_cluster, "year_cluster": year_cluster,
        "level_sign": sigma, "e0_per_level": float(e0_per_ell),
        "epochs": epochs, "epoch_years": yrs_cat, "epoch_windows": win,
    }

art = artifacts.stage(
    "clustering", _assemble,
    inputs=["tucker", "tensor", "hmd_raw", "populations", "clustering_gmm", "clustering_reproducibility",
            "clustering_bootstrap"],
    params={"features": PF, "gmm": PG, "stability": {**REPRO_KEY, **BOOT_KEY,
                                                      "reproducibility_ari": PSt["reproducibility_ari"]},
            "epochs": PE, "diagnostics": PX},
    code=[_assemble, clus],
    desc="Level-free clusters of observed country-years, conditional-mean core, deviations, e0, and level epochs")
print({k_: (getattr(v, "shape", None) or type(v).__name__) for k_, v in art.items()})

# Check the recipe above on one cluster: the schedule at the mean e0 of its members.
k_chk = int(np.argmax(sizes))
x_chk = float(art["member_mean_e0"][k_chk])
core_chk = clus.conditional_core_at(x_chk, art["conditional_mean"]["e0_grid"], art["conditional_mean"]["core"]) \
    + art["residual_core"][k_chk]
e0_chk = lifetable.e0_from_logit(tz.schedules_from_cores(core_chk, U_sex, U_age)).mean()
print(f"Recipe check, {CNAME[k_chk]}: target e0 {x_chk:.2f}, e0 of the generated schedule {e0_chk:.2f}")
```

# Supplementary diagnostics {.unnumbered}

**Other specifications.**  The table repeats the BIC search with shared
(`tied`) and diagonal (`diag`) covariance matrices, with other numbers of
age columns $c_{\text{feat}}$, with other LOWESS spans for the conditional mean, and with
the residuals also divided by their e₀-conditional root-mean-square
("standardised"), using `{python} f"{P.clustering.supplementary.sensitivity_n_init}"`
EM starts per $K$, and once more on a tensor built **without pooling**
(chapter d5): the same specification, with the bases and effective cores
estimated again from the unpooled schedules.  For each it reports the $K$
with the lowest BIC, whether it lies at a bound of the range, how strongly
the clusters are tied to e₀ and year, how many clusters the noise rule of
Step 8 flags, and — since the chapter does not choose $K$ by BIC — the $K$
of the rule of Step 5 (refits from the same seeds, with
`{python} f"{PG['n_init']}"` EM starts each, as in Step 5).  The variants
inform only: nothing downstream uses them, and this section is in the companion only.

```{python}
#| label: c06-sensitivity
#| code-summary: "Repeat the search under other specifications (cached)"

def _variant_features(n_columns, frac, standardise):
    """Level-free features for one variant of the specification."""
    idx_v = clus.feature_index(r1, n_columns)
    raw_v = clus.cores_to_features(G_obs, idx_v)
    cm_v = {**cm, "frac": frac}
    fit_v, _ = clus.conditional_mean(e0, raw_v, **cm_v)
    res_v = raw_v - fit_v
    if standardise:
        scale2, _ = clus.conditional_mean(e0, res_v ** 2, **cm_v)
        res_v = res_v / np.sqrt(np.clip(scale2, 1e-12, None))
    return res_v

from mdmx import smoothing

cur_lt = artifacts.load("lt_curated")["lt"]
ev_labels = artifacts.load("event_labels")
pop_reg = artifacts.load("populations")


def _nopool_features():
    """Level-free features (n_obs, p) of the observed country-years from a tensor built without pooling.

    The tensor of chapter d6, the bases and effective cores of chapter 04 (the
    age rank held at its value with pooling, r₂) and the features of Steps 2-3,
    all from the curated life tables before chapter d5 pools them.
    """
    tn = data.build_tensor(cur_lt, ev_labels, q_min=P.data.q_min,
                           min_observed_years=P.data.min_observed_years, populations=pop_reg)
    if not np.array_equal(tn["observed"], tucker["observed"]):
        raise ValueError("Without pooling the observed country-years differ; the variant is not comparable.")
    Mz_n = np.nan_to_num(tn["M"])
    b = tz.sex_age_bases(Mz_n, tn["observed"], tau=P.tucker.tau, age_bounds=(r2, r2))
    U_a, _ = smoothing.smooth_age_basis(b["U_age"], P.tucker.smooth_components, P.tucker.smooth_rest_sigma,
                                       P.tucker.smooth_preserve, P.tucker.smooth_orth_tol)
    G_n = clus.observed_cores(tz.effective_cores(Mz_n, tn["observed"], b["U_sex"], U_a), c_idx, t_idx)
    e0_n = clus.observed_e0(tn["M"], c_idx, t_idx).mean(axis=1)
    raw_n = clus.cores_to_features(G_n, clus.feature_index(r1, k_cols))
    fit_n, _ = clus.conditional_mean(e0_n, raw_n, **{**cm, "grid": clus.e0_grid(e0_n, PF["e0_grid_step"])})
    return raw_n - fit_n


def _rule_k(X_v, cov):
    """K of the agreed rule (Step 5) for features X_v, and the refits' mean ARI at it."""
    table, _ = clus.reproducibility_sweep(
        X_v, k_values, repro_seeds, workers=PSt["workers"], covariance_type=cov,
        **{k_: PG[k_] for k_ in ("n_init", "max_iter", "tol", "reg_covar")})
    k_rule = clus.choose_k_reproducible(table, PSt["reproducibility_ari"])
    return k_rule, float(table.set_index("K").loc[k_rule, "ari_mean"])


def _sensitivity():
    variants = [(f"{cov} covariance", k_cols, PF["conditional_frac"], False, cov)
                for cov in PS["sensitivity_covariance"]]
    variants += [(f"c_feat = {k_}", k_, PF["conditional_frac"], False, PG["covariance_type"])
                 for k_ in PS["sensitivity_columns"]]
    variants += [(f"LOWESS span {f_}", k_cols, f_, False, PG["covariance_type"])
                 for f_ in PS["sensitivity_frac"]]
    if PS["sensitivity_standardised"]:
        variants.append(("standardised residuals", k_cols, PF["conditional_frac"], True, PG["covariance_type"]))
    variants.append(("no pooling", k_cols, PF["conditional_frac"], False, PG["covariance_type"]))
    rows, all_labels = [], []
    for name, k_, f_, std, cov in variants:
        res_v = _nopool_features() if name == "no pooling" else _variant_features(k_, f_, std)
        X_v = clus.pca_fit(res_v, PF["pca_variance"])["scores"]
        settings = {**gmm_settings, "covariance_type": cov, "n_init": PS["sensitivity_n_init"]}
        table, models = clus.bic_sweep(X_v, k_values, **settings)
        ranked_v = table.sort_values("bic").reset_index(drop=True)
        k_best = int(ranked_v.loc[0, "K"])
        k_rule, ari_rule = _rule_k(X_v, cov)
        rows.append({"variant": name, "R² e0 ~ features": clus.linear_r_squared(e0, res_v), "K": k_best,
                     "runner-up K": int(ranked_v.loc[1, "K"]),
                     "BIC margin": float(ranked_v.loc[1, "bic"] - ranked_v.loc[0, "bic"]),
                     "rule K": k_rule, "ARI at rule K": ari_rule})
        all_labels.append(models[k_best].predict(X_v))
    return {"summary": pd.DataFrame(rows), "labels": np.vstack(all_labels)}

sens = artifacts.stage(
    "clustering_sensitivity", _sensitivity,
    inputs=["tucker", "tensor", "lt_curated", "event_labels", "populations"],
    params={"features": PF, "gmm": PG, "supplementary": PS, "stability": REPRO_KEY,
            "rule": PSt["reproducibility_ari"], "data": P.section("data"), "tucker": P.section("tucker")},
    code=[_sensitivity, _variant_features, _nopool_features, _rule_k, clus.feature_index,
          clus.cores_to_features, clus.conditional_mean, clus.pca_fit, clus.bic_sweep, clus.fit_gmm,
          clus.gmm_n_parameters, clus.reproducibility_sweep, clus.choose_k_reproducible,
          data.build_tensor, tz.sex_age_bases, tz.effective_cores, smoothing.smooth_age_basis],
    desc="Clustering under other specifications (supplementary)")
# The chapter's specification with K chosen by BIC, like the variants (the chapter itself uses
# the reproducible K of Step 5).
spec_rows = [{"variant": f"chapter: c_feat = {k_cols}, {PG['covariance_type']} covariance",
              "R² e0 ~ features": rsq_res, "K": K_bic, "runner-up K": k_second, "BIC margin": bic_margin,
              "rule K": K, "ARI at rule K": float(repro_table.set_index("K").loc[K, "ari_mean"])}]
spec_rows += sens["summary"].to_dict("records")
spec_labels = [fit["fits"][str(K_bic)]["labels"]] + list(sens["labels"])
for row, lab_v in zip(spec_rows, spec_labels, strict=True):
    k_v = int(lab_v.max()) + 1
    noise_v = clus.noise_diagnostics(lab_v, k_v, excess_rough, small,
                                     roughness_ratio=PX["noise_roughness_ratio"], small_share=PX["noise_small_share"])
    row["at bound"] = row["K"] in (PG["k_min"], PG["k_max"])
    row["smallest"] = int(np.bincount(lab_v).min())
    row["largest"] = int(np.bincount(lab_v).max())
    row["eta2 e0"] = clus.eta_squared(e0, lab_v)
    row["eta2 year"] = clus.eta_squared(obs_year.astype(float), lab_v)
    row["noise clusters"] = int(noise_v["noise"].sum())
    row["in noise clusters"] = int(noise_v.loc[noise_v["noise"], "n"].sum())
table_s = pd.DataFrame(spec_rows)
table_s.round(3)
```

```{python}
#| label: c06-sensitivity-text
#| output: asis
#| code-summary: "Text: what the comparison shows"
row = {r_["variant"]: r_ for r_ in table_s.to_dict("records")}
tied, diag = row["tied covariance"], row["diag covariance"]
std = row["standardised residuals"]
k_rows = [r_ for v_, r_ in row.items() if v_.startswith("c_feat = ")]
print(f"With a shared covariance matrix (tied), one cluster holds {tied['largest']:,} of "
      f"{n_obs:,} country-years and the others are small satellites "
      f"(smallest {tied['smallest']}), {tied['noise clusters']} of them flagged as noise. "
      f"With diagonal covariances BIC chooses K = {diag['K']}"
      f"{' — the upper bound of the range' if diag['at bound'] else ''}. "
      f"Other numbers of age columns give K = {', '.join(str(r_['K']) for r_ in k_rows)} "
      f"for c_feat = {', '.join(v_[len('c_feat = '):] for v_, r_ in row.items() if v_.startswith('c_feat = '))}, each with "
      f"{', '.join(str(r_['noise clusters']) for r_ in k_rows)} noise cluster(s); the smallest k gives "
      f"clusters much less tied to e₀ (η² {min(r_['eta2 e0'] for r_ in k_rows):.2f} against "
      f"{spec_rows[0]['eta2 e0']:.2f} for the chapter's specification, both at the K with the lowest BIC). "
      f"The LOWESS span changes K but little else. "
      f"If the residuals are also divided by their e₀-conditional root-mean-square, BIC finds "
      f"K = {std['K']} with a smallest cluster of {std['smallest']} and a margin of "
      f"{std['BIC margin']:.0f}: almost all of the cluster structure disappears, which shows that "
      "much of it comes from differences in the *spread* of deviations between eras and levels "
      "of mortality. ")
chapter_row = spec_rows[0]
print("\n\nThe chapter keeps unrestricted covariance matrices with k chosen by the stated rule: it is "
      f"the specification the paper describes; with it BIC chooses K = {chapter_row['K']}"
      f"{' — the upper bound of the range' if chapter_row['at bound'] else ''}, the largest cluster holds "
      f"{chapter_row['largest']:,} country-years, and {chapter_row['noise clusters']} cluster(s) are "
      "flagged as noise.  Shared covariances produce a catch-all cluster, and diagonal covariances "
      f"push K to the bound.  The chapter itself uses the reproducible K = {K} of Step 5: refits of "
      f"its BIC partition from other starting values agree only at a mean ARI of {ari_at[K_bic]:.2f}.")
rule_ks = [int(r_["rule K"]) for r_ in spec_rows[1:]]
k_nopool = int(row["no pooling"]["rule K"])
print(f"\n\nUnder the rule of Step 5, K is {', '.join(map(str, rule_ks))} across the variants "
      f"(the chapter: {K}); on the tensor without pooling it is {k_nopool}.  The rule's K is therefore "
      + ("stable" if min(rule_ks) == max(rule_ks) == K else "sensitive to the specification and to small changes in the data")
      + ", like the clusters themselves (Step 6).")
latex.report("clusSensKRuleMin", min(rule_ks), desc="Smallest K of the agreed rule across the sensitivity variants")
latex.report("clusSensKRuleMax", max(rule_ks), desc="Largest K of the agreed rule across the sensitivity variants")
latex.report("clusSensKRuleNoPool", k_nopool, desc="K of the agreed rule on the tensor without pooling")
latex.report("clusSensNVariants", len(rule_ks), desc="Sensitivity variants (specifications and the tensor without pooling)")
```
